mapper.insert: insert into comment (content, note_id, parent_comment_id, user_id, like_count, created_at) values (#{content}, #{noteId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{userId}, #{likeCount}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: update comment set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = #{targetId};
update comment set like_count = like_count - 1 where id = #{targetId};
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.avatar AS userAvatar, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.content, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.note_id = #{noteId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
